title: Cubic Staged Exact Certification
objective: Certify bounded complex-cubic relation prefixes and resume only on explicit mathematical insufficiency within the same resident native computation

oracles: PARI and independent exact certificate replay

handoff.summary: Implemented the bounded effort-five two-attempt driver (n+6 then n+22) using one resident collector and root-owned proof scratch. Shared extracted mathematical helpers preserve the one-shot path. Explicit insufficiency alone permits resumption; unknown/fatal statuses fail closed, no-progress skips a repeated proof, and Smith data is refreshed after appended rows. Current direct fmpz execution returns the expected class numbers on four known fields; twenty adversarial actual-root scheduler scenarios pass. Full production qualification and controlled performance evidence remain pending. Earlier recorded runs retain their original workspace fingerprints and do not qualify this revision.
risks: The staged implementation has no new controlled PARI speed claim. Four known-field successes do not establish frontier coverage.
Standalone ASan/UBSan core checks on four fields fit the 3 MiB checkpoint without retries, exhaustion or upstream allocations, but do not yet qualify a real two-proof-attempt case or the full regime.
The source family measures 480058 bytes within the integration-owned 485000 allowance. Architecture checks stop at stale optimizer provenance, which requires an integration-owned refresh.
Full current-source native/platform qualification remains pending; prerequisite baseline separately reproduces rational cache-pressure and synthetic portable discriminant-ratio gate failures.
Frozen f7f00552 timings retain the target and show a substantial PARI gap. None of the twenty registered neighbors has executed; freeze the candidate before using them.
next_steps: Finish the production rebuild and authenticated receipt/replay regressions for the combined staged implementation.
Find a previously exposed real field requiring both proof attempts and qualify its exact replay and retained-state memory behavior.
Qualify complete scratch at <=3 MiB with one core invocation and zero retry shift, exhaustion or upstream allocation; use the integrated generic prefix-Arb binding.
